name: soundwerk
description: A wall of synthesizers, oscilloscopes, sequencers and patch cables in the browser: a modular synth for techno and acid.

scripts.stems:setup: python3 -m venv tools/stems/.venv && tools/stems/.venv/bin/pip install -r tools/stems/requirements.txt
scripts.vst:setup: python3 -m venv tools/vst/.venv && tools/vst/.venv/bin/pip install -r tools/vst/requirements.txt
